title: Ranveer Singh Will Play Lord Shiva in Meluha Trilogy
excerpt: The actor acquires Amish Tripathi's beloved novel and partners with Birla Studios for a three-film mythological universe
body:
Ranveer Singh just claimed the most coveted role in Indian mythological fiction. The actor has acquired the rights to Amish Tripathi's *The Immortals of Meluha* under his production banner, Maa Kasam Film, and will himself portray Lord Shiva across a three-part cinematic trilogy developed in partnership with Birla Studios.

**What happened:**
Singh and Ananya Birla are actively collaborating on the project, which sits in the writing stage as of May 2025. The team has set an ambitious target: filming for the first installment begins in 2028. The rights acquisition reportedly cost a substantial sum, though exact figures remain undisclosed.

**Why this matters:**
Tripathi's Shiva Trilogy is the fastest-selling book series in Indian publishing history, with millions of devoted readers who have waited over a decade for a credible screen adaptation. The novel reimagines Shiva not as a deity from birth but as a tribal chief from Tibet who earns his godhood through valor and moral reckoning — a character demanding an actor with explosive physicality and emotional range. Industry insiders say the production targets international scale, with world-class VFX and a cinematic universe approach unfolding across all three films. A director will only be confirmed once the screenplay reaches a mature stage, signaling that the team prioritizes story architecture above all else.

**What to watch:**
All eyes now turn to the casting of Sati and the selection of a director — two decisions that will signal whether this long-dreamed adaptation finally matches the scale Tripathi's source material demands.
